How We Work

From ore to weapon.

Four stages, no mystery invoices, and a working demo in your hands every week from the first.

01

The Spark

A short discovery call. We ask the questions a top engineer would, and tell you honestly if AI is the wrong tool for your problem.

02

The Blueprint

A fixed-scope proposal in days — defined outcomes, honest timelines, transparent pricing. You know the cost before we start.

03

The Forging

Weekly demos of the real system. Your first working prototype lands before most agencies finish onboarding paperwork.

04

The Quenching

Production hardening, evaluation harnesses, monitoring and handover. What leaves the forge keeps working after we leave.
